0x87fec.why: text_of sets s0 = a1 at 0x87e04 (no frame record of its own); a1 is LLVMFuzzerTestOneInput's slot address s1+0x130 (calls 0x82e24, 0x837d8) or s1+0x128 (call 0x82e34). The walk reads the word at s0-8 as the next return address: 0x128(s1) is written only by text_of itself (its result, a heap pointer that 0x82e74 frees, or 0) and holds a stale stack word before the first such call; 0x120(s1) is the cursor's remaining input length. The image does not determine that word, so no constant tail can be listed: the listed trace is the walk that ends at the first record, which holds exactly when the word is below 4096.
